combo_label: The Sunday Roast × Sewing & Knitting × Ancient Egypt

entries.clue: Of the four stoppered jars that held a body's inner organs
Of beef, still red in the middle - and the opposite of common
Translucent white stone cut into vessels and lamps
Swedish-invented cast-iron range cooker of 1922, never switched off
Paper template of shapes to be pinned down, cut round and followed
Hooded snake reared at the royal brow to spit fire at foes
Jackal-headed guardian who weighed hearts against a feather
Slim steel sliver with a thread-carrying eye, driven through fabric by hand or machine
Beetle carved as a charm, emblem of the rising sun
Test square knitted up before the real work begins, to check stitches to the inch
Fastener that mates with an eye on a dress, or the crooked tool for looping wool
Cut of pork from along the back, where the best chops come from
Curved chest bone, and the beef joint roasted on a row of them
